question: What event at the time of bodily dissolution marks the culminating moment described to the goddess?
premises: The time of bodily fall is specified.
The skull is said to be pierced at that time.
inference: At the moment of bodily dissolution, the piercing of the skull occurs.
uncertainties: The fused form kapālambhidyate is read as kapālam + bhidyate.
plain_english: O goddess, when the body falls, then the skull is pierced.
